title: Val3dityValidateResponse
description: Reply 200 of POST /validate (3D-74; 3D-ADR-0008): the validator identity and val3dity's own JSON report, passed through unchanged by the image's wrapper. The service adapter maps `features[].errors[]` and `dataset_errors[]` to port findings (`externalValidatorCode` = the code as a string) and val3dity ids to kernel entity ids.
$comment: D-446. `report` is val3dity's format (2.7.0, `src/input.cpp` build_report, `src/Feature.cpp` get_report_json): only the members the adapter reads are required; val3dity's other members (time, input_file, overviews, all_errors, ...) are allowed and ignored [A]. Error `id` of a feature error reads `coid=<CityObject id>|geom=<geometry index>|shell=<shell>|face=<face>` (observed, GT-I2: `coid=bld-gt-i2|geom=0|shell=0|face=`); it is a string the adapter parses, not a contract of its own.
